text:
You need a 5-page technical/grant proposal for an AI project, including diagrams and charts, and you want someone who can write it clearly and persuasively.  

I’m Noor Halden, and I have 6 years of experience in AI and machine learning, with Python, PyTorch, scikit-learn, LangChain, OpenAI API, Hugging Face Transformers, NLP, XGBoost, pandas, and machine learning. I’ve also written AI systems that required careful technical framing.  

In a contract clause search assistant, I built an assistant over 9,000 contracts that always quoted the clause and page used, and it reached 0.91 faithfulness on a 120-question lawyer-written test set. In private wiki question answering, I built an on-premise assistant over 14k pages of engineering standards, with an 82% top-3 hit rate on 60 engineer questions.  

I can help turn your project into a concise, credible proposal with a strong technical narrative.
